title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Surpasses Estimated $1.5 Billion In Revenue—Two Days Before Release
summary: “Grand Theft Auto VI” has already made $1.5 billion in pre-orders with just two days until the game is released, according to estimates by market data firm Sensor Tower.
